standard.coverage: FLSA-covered employers only. This state has enacted no minimum wage law at all, so an employee NOT covered by the FLSA has no minimum wage floor in this state.
standard.note: DOL lists Mississippi among the five states with no state minimum wage law; the $7.25 shown here is the federal rate reaching through, not a state rate.

tipped.note: Federal FLSA figures -- there is no state tip-credit law to be more protective.

youthAndTraining.label: Federal youth opportunity wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 consecutive calendar days -- 29 U.S.C. 206(g). Not a state figure; carried here because it is the only sub-minimum wage available in this state.

knownGaps: Because coverage is purely federal here, an employee outside FLSA coverage (a small non-enterprise employer with no interstate commerce nexus) is genuinely subject to no minimum wage. This database records the rate, not that coverage determination.
